heading.title: Social Security, Health, Rehabilitation and Recreation

article.title: Research and development.
article.content: The appropriate Government shall initiate or cause to be initiated research and development through individuals and institutions on issues which shall enhance habilitation and rehabilitation and on such other issues which are necessary for the empowerment of persons with disabilities.
article.html:
28Research and development.

Section 28 · Chapter V · page 15 of the Act

The appropriate Government shall initiate or cause to be initiated research and development through individuals and institutions on issues which shall enhance habilitation and rehabilitation and on such other issues which are necessary for the empowerment of persons with disabilities.
